policyChange.exactDiff: if (cappedGame && o.geometryAccepted === 0 && finite(o.visualR) && o.visualR > 0) upper = Math.max(upper, (o.visualR + 6) / .808); before original clipped expansion and200 cap; diagnostics and naming do not change decisions
policyChange.rationale: rejected geometric radius refinement can leave a narrow outline-based size interval and create false meals or miss threatening bodies
policyChange.unchanged: v2.13 policy, accepted geometry, ordinary food, centre/radius estimates, tracking, red marker rules, original hard/soft rule, target value, scouts, immunity, motion prediction, path horizon and weights; no Grow18 nominal-lethal hard condition
policyChange.hypothesis: a larger fallback upper may reduce radius-underestimation errors, but can discard genuinely edible prey, increase avoidance and reduce growth; fixed synthetic negative cases are retained and no live improvement is claimed
policyChange.bounds: V>=.808R is a relation for a complete unoccluded continuous outline. Current components do not certify that condition; the6-unit step3/ratio1 allowance is a policy constant, not an occlusion or sampling guarantee
policyChange.diagnostic: boundAdjustedCount counts deduplicated NPC bodies whose upper is increased after original clipped expansion and200 cap, before map-red association/red expansion and local-hazard filtering; it is not a count of deaths avoided or final local threats

protocol.instrumentationChange: additional numeric selected-target coordinates/motion/stall/blocked fields and boundAdjustedCount; the reviewed Grow18 saving/stopping template is retained: startup page/harness/planner SHA-256 verification, independent100ms visible-stop watchdog, save abort after2500ms with unconfirmed records displayed for reconciliation, win without visible result time is unknown; no pixels or hidden state

perception.minimap: strict growMarkers for candidate; no permissive white fallback
perception.plannerLogic: Grow15 with one v2.22 geometry-rejected upper-floor addition; original hard/soft rule and all other strategy choices unchanged
perception.geometry: frozen geometry.js; accepted pixel centre AND radius converted by capture ratio; null preserves original; NPCs only

confirmation.condition: both versions have exactly four native screen finals and >=2 wins each; frozen same candidate; 12 new starts per version; no data pooling

success.evidence: this run visible You win settlement and visible result Play time <=02:30; HUD may stop updating during ending animation

stop.gameDeadline: visible HUD elapsed >150 (integer display, normally151); settlement checked first
stop.manual: stop batch records controller_abort and releases all held keys
stop.persistenceFailure: stop and retain infrastructure_error or unconfirmed visible records; reconcile by runId before sidecar, no replacements; unconfirmed final never triggers a second final; server rejects duplicate start/final identities

protocol.denominatorPolicy: every start stays in its version and phase denominator; death, cutoff, late win, infrastructure error, abort and unknown are separately reported; no replacements, exclusions or restarting an interrupted batch
protocol.acceptance: research only: both confirmation versions require >=6/12 observed wins for this sample target; report Wilson 95% intervals; no formal OCR4 release, all-version acceptance or long-term guarantee
unsupportedClaims: synthetic fixtures are not game outcomes
historical uncontrolled batches do not establish causal improvement
